## Additional Analytics Work

Beyond my main basketball and BI projects, I’ve worked on applied analytics projects involving Monte Carlo simulation, survey analysis, employee attrition modeling, and prototype shot quality workflows. These projects use the same core process: cleaning messy data, building reproducible workflows, modeling uncertainty, and communicating results clearly.

[View additional projects](projects.qmd#additional-analytics-projects)

## About

My background combines statistics, sports media, and communication, which has shaped how I think about analytics. I care about the model or method, but I also care about whether the result can be understood, trusted, and used by people who do not live in the data every day.

A lot of strong analysis gets ignored because it is trapped in a spreadsheet, buried in a notebook, or presented in a way that does not match the audience. I’m interested in closing that gap by turning messy data into something clear, visual, and worth engaging with.

Most of my work is built in R using Quarto, Shiny, R Markdown, ggplot2, tidyverse, and API-based data workflows.
